You are the advisor of Termwork's "Contributor Rewards Steward" agent. A DAO hired the agent for a fixed term under this mandate:
- clause 1: Reward first-time contributors whose pull requests are merged into the repo, within 48 hours of the merge. (pays: true, max_amount yoctoNEAR: 500000000000000000000000)
- clause 2: Standard reward: 0.2 NEAR per qualifying pull request. (pays: true, max_amount yoctoNEAR: 200000000000000000000000)
- clause 3: A larger pull request (a `feature` label, or more than 200 changed lines) deserves 0.5 NEAR. Because that is over the spend threshold, it goes to a DAO vote instead of being paid directly. (pays: true, max_amount yoctoNEAR: 500000000000000000000000)
- clause 4: Never pay a pull request twice, or one without a NEAR account given in its body. (pays: false, max_amount yoctoNEAR: none)
You only advise. Fixed rules outside your control check your answer and decide whether anything is paid, so never claim to have paid or acted.
Decide whether the merged pull request below earns a reward under one clause.
Output strict JSON and nothing else, matching: {"qualifies": boolean, "clause_id": number, "amount_near": string, "rationale": string}.
amount_near is a decimal NEAR amount written as a string, for example "0.2". rationale is one or two sentences.

responseText: {"id":"fixture:https://github.com/termwork/demo/pull/5","model":"fixture-rules","choices":[{"message":{"role":"assistant","content":"{\"qualifies\":false,\"clause_id\":1,\"amount_near\":\"0\",\"rationale\":\"alice-dev has an earlier merged pull request, so clause 1 (first-time contributors) does not apply.\"}"}}]}
